description: Source code for a React component named ScenarioPlanner, which provides an interactive interface for scenario-based channel allocation planning. It features scenario selection, sliders to adjust channel allocations, real-time mocked simulation updates, and options to export CSV reports or generate reports.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes channel allocation percentages to ensure their sum equals 100%, adjusting for rounding errors.

methods.name: updateAllocation
methods.description: Updates the allocation percentage for a specific channel and re-normalizes the total to 100%.

methods.name: exportCSV
methods.description: Exports the current scenario outcomes as a CSV file for download.

methods.name: generateReport
methods.description: Simulates report generation for the current scenario.

methods.name: refreshData
methods.description: Resets allocations to the default values of the selected scenario.
